title: Find your next good move
description: A friendly starting point for your next creative project.

steps.title: Where are you starting?
steps.body: Every good project begins with a little clarity. What does yours look like?

steps.title: What needs a little shape?
steps.body: Think about the first thing that will help your idea feel real.

steps.title: What would make it better?
steps.body: A small, thoughtful change can make a surprisingly big difference.

steps.title: Start with a little identity.
steps.body: Collect three references you love. Write down what your project should feel like. Then explore a small set of colors, words, and shapes.

steps.title: Make one useful page.
steps.body: Choose one thing your visitor should be able to do. Sketch the shortest path to it, and turn that sketch into a small working prototype.

steps.title: Listen, then simplify.
steps.body: Watch someone use the current experience. Find one point of friction. Improve it, try again, and keep what makes the journey clearer.
